policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'warned him of' renders a 3ms object suffix on the verb, the qere וְהִזְהִירוֹ; the ketiv והזהירה carries a 3fs suffix ('warned her/it') with no feminine referent the ASV wording reflects.

ASV 'dove's dung' is equally the qere דִּבְיוֹנִים and the ketiv חרי יונים, which the qere euphemistically replaces with the same sense; the English does not distinguish them. Both verse notes are alternative_rendering ('Or, shekels') and concern the silver, not this unit. Base qere fallback retained.
